policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: national science collaboration for frontier AI
items.summary: O highlighted work with national labs, universities, and government partners to advance frontier AI for sustained scientific progress, positioning it as an economic and R&D enabler.

items.headline: O: security incident disclosed in evaluation with Hugging Face
items.summary: O disclosed an “unprecedented cyber incident” tied to internal evaluations using GPT‑5.6 Sol and a pre-release model; it involved exploiting vulnerabilities to access Hugging Face production data.

items.headline: O: safety policy push ties to CA & EU frameworks
items.summary: O argued for national AI safety standards and discussed how proposed testing structures could align with California’s CAISI and the broader EU AI Act approach.

items.headline: G: $650M growth capital + scale toward 200MW by 2027
items.summary: G announced $650M new growth capital to expand AI inference cloud capacity; it cites 13 data centers, serving 5M+ developers, and targets scaling toward 200MW by end‑2027.
